cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import re
src = open("tmp/tests3.py").read()
# convert these checks from frm= to to= and expect To wire line
for user, host, exp in [
    ("ember@1.2.3.4", None, None),
]:
    pass
lines = src.split("\n")
out = []
for ln in lines:
    if ('w1(req(frm="sip:ember@' in ln or 'one(req(frm="sip:ember@' in ln or 'frej(req(frm="sip:ember@' in ln) and "STUDIO" not in ln and "%65" not in ln:
        ln = ln.replace('req(frm="sip:ember@', 'req(to="sip:ember@')
        ln = ln.replace('w1(', 'TOCHK(').replace('one(', 'one(')
        ln = ln.replace('"From: <sip:ember@', '"To: <sip:ember@')
    out.append(ln)
src = "\n".join(out)
src = src.replace('def w1(raw):', 'def TOCHK(raw):\n    return one(raw)["wire"].split("\\r\\n")[2]\n\ndef w1(raw):')
open("tmp/tests3.py","w").write(src)
PYEOF
grep -n "TOCHK\|one(req(to=\"sip:ember@\|frej(req(to=" tmp/tests3.py | head -30
